newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Austria, Hungary firms to set up building society.
newsitem.headline: Austria, Hungary firms to set up building society.

text.p: A group of Hungarian and Austrian insurers and banks announced plans on Wednesday to set up a network of building society branches across Hungary .
The Hungarian Parliament on Tuesday approved a bill, which will become law in January 1, allowing the creation of building societies in the country for the first time.
"We will be present at least at 3,600 points in the country," Erno Nagy, a spokesman of the group told a news conference. "At the moment no one else can offer such coverage."
The group will set up a joint building society, Lakaskassza Rt, in which Austria's insurance group EA Generali will control 52 percent of the initial registered capital of one billion forints.

Both Hungary's Postabank Rt and the Hungarian banking arm of Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein CABV-pa.VI will have a 21 percent stake in Lakaskassza, while the Oesterreichische Volksbanken AG's banking unit in Hungary will hold a six percent stake.
Lakaskassza will sell state-subsidized savings products in 3,200 post offices in Hungary, in addition to the branches of the building society's shareholders.

Lakaskassza spokesman Karoly Gergely told Reuters that the strongest competitors of Lakaskassza are likely to be Hungary's largest commercial bank OTP, and Takarekbank Rt, which represents savings cooperatives and is likely to enter the market in association with Germany's Bausparkasse Schwabish Hall.
